notes: Room reasoning, two-storey rooms, split linked floors and corridors that turn.

features: Click a room in a finished design to see why it has what it has, with Explain in plain words. A room drawn on two storeys (a gym, an auditorium) is designed once at its real height: wall devices on the lower plan, ceiling devices on the upper. Corridors that turn are designed leg by leg under NFPA 72 18.5.5.5.
fixes: Linked rooms on a split floor level (a few feet above the host level) are read instead of dropped. Lighting and power design a model whose lowest level has no rooms.
